components.name: Card
components.description:
Figma Card (6643:51021): a Content slot on one of six surfaces, padded Card-padding-medium/small.
A clickable card is an actionable container: Border theme steps its stroke up to Border/Neutral/Subtle (§6).

props.name: width
props.description:
Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding
and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full
width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap.
A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box).
(Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.)
Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame).

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text.

props.name: alignSelf
props.description:
This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's
direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align`
for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth
stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid.

props.name: theme
props.description:
Figma Theme: Shadow (Shadow/Bottom/Level-1) · Flat · Pale (Support/Neutral/Pale + Effect/Overlay blur) · Border ·
 On-Container (Surface/Flat: a card inside a Modal, Side Panel or Bottom Sheet, on their Container fill; harness
 card/on-container-in-overlay). `semi-pale` is deprecated (no gradients in Figma since 2026-10-14) and renders as pale.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Figma Spacing: Medium (Card-padding-medium, Corner-Radius/2XLarge) · Small (Card-padding-small, Corner-Radius/Large). Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: selected
props.description: Figma Active=Yes: the selected card — Surface fill with a 2px Card/Border/Active stroke.

props.name: surface
props.description:
Surface/Default or Surface/Alt, chosen to suit the page's Canvas. Unset follows an inherited --zen-card-surface
 (a page scope can set it once), else Surface/Default. Pale / On-Container keep their own fill. With theme="shadow",
 `alt` drops the drop shadow (Surface-Alt never casts one, §9) and the card renders as Figma Theme=Flat (6643:51018)
 on Surface/Alt; an inherited alt surface cannot do this, so pass surface="alt" explicitly on an alt page.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the whole card one action (role=button, Enter/Space). Keep other controls out of clickable cards.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for a clickable card when its content does not start with a clear title.

props.name: subAction
props.description:
Figma Sub-Action: an absolute layer over the top-right corner holding Button/Icon-Flat Small Secondary (default ⋮).
 It takes no room: the Content slot keeps the full width. A node (e.g. a Menu) should use the same trigger.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the Zen components the card draws itself, by layer (`{ "Sub-Action": { level:
 "primary" } }`, `"Sub-Action/Leading-Icon"` one level deeper). Written by Zen Studio; app code sets `subAction`.

types.CardSubAction: interface CardSubAction { label: string; icon?: IconName | ReactElement; onClick?: () => void; }
